provenance: synthetic, hand-written, NOT MBTA data; every value below was derived by hand from design C and spec md 11/17 (see PROVENANCE.md), never from the implementation

conventions.instants: UTC ISO-8601 with second precision and a trailing Z; consumers must compare parsed instants, not strings (the API uses millisecond precision)
conventions.labels: pointer, deliveries, inherited_from, first_seen and closed_by use fixture capture labels; map them to run-specific snapshot ids through the materialization label map
conventions.vehicle_metrics: serving view recomputed at the step clock (API)
conventions.vehicle_generation_metrics: as stored by Spark for the pointer generation at feeds.vehicle_positions.metrics_as_of (route_metrics_by_snapshot)
conventions.vehicles: valid rows: full record; invalid rows (frozen invalid_reason): route_id, class, age_s, invalid_reason, flags only
conventions.history: cumulative vehicle_observations_by_day rows of valid vehicles; history of invalid vehicles is not asserted
conventions.prediction_metrics: values as of feeds.trip_updates.metrics_as_of; stale is recomputed at the step clock (header age > 90 s)
conventions.targets: one entry per trip instance (keyed by trip_id); late is null unless the instance is KPI-eligible
conventions.alerts_by_route: state recomputed at the step clock; confirmation CONFIRMED or UNCONFIRMED_INHERITED
conventions.null: null is a value and is compared strictly; numbers are compared with absolute tolerance 1e-9
